_comment: DoomArena3D HUD v3.0 — multi-chamber. Top-left shows Chamber name (binds world.current_level), kills, HP, ammo, chamber-elapsed. Win latches on world.all_levels_complete=1 (set after Core boss-kill transition). Lose at HP=0. Per-chamber elapsed resets on level transition (each chamber has its own clock instance).

panels._: Bottom-right weapon indicator. Shows current weapon (1/2/3) + cooldown bar.
Centered crosshair — points at where bullets actually go.

controls_hint:
WASD walk · Mouse aim · SPACE fire
1/2/3 swap weapon · ESC release cursor
R restart · Q quit
